title: C29 structural fallback ignored the disabled automatic-productivity action

reproduction.error: disabled action attached an automatic recipe
reproduction.observed: The reviewed stable Belt Productivity stream retained its explicit recipes, but the new structural fallback also attached the fixture recipe assemble-alpha while mir-automatic-productivity-action was disabled.

root_cause.summary: Structural fallback groups were resolved independently of the automatic compiler policy. The stream-match cache identity also omitted the automatic action, so a cached structural result could not safely distinguish disabled, report, attach, and generate modes.

regression_propositions: disabled automatic-productivity action never attaches structural fallback recipes
report action does not mutate emitted technology effects
attach and generate actions retain their authorized structural behavior
reviewed explicit vanilla and provider attachments remain available when automatic structural discovery is disabled
stream-match identity includes the exact automatic-productivity action
exact C30 semantic-family off, report, attach, generate, and exact-pack scenarios pass

closure.proof_required: complete exact C30 runtime closure, candidate aggregate, manual acceptance, protected qualification, seal, promotion, and published 3.2.3 bytes
